name: probe-research
description: Probe Research: experiment tracking for agentic ML/RL training. Skills for opening a tracked run, for capturing, verifying and closing it, and for drawing the whole research arc as one timeline in the session, wired to a read-only Probe Research MCP server. A SessionStart hook nudges you when the CLI or plugin is out of date. Writes go through the `probe` CLI (installed via /probe-research-setup) or, in-process from training scripts, the Python SDK (`import probe`, PyPI: probe-research).
